item.title: From neutral to +1
item.content:encoded:
Took me a while to consider whether I liked the change or not (admittedly, the gut reaction to basically turn the thing into an anti-joke by reversing the entire article made me decide "nope" at first, particularly w/r/t Joke SCPs voting seemingly mostly being subject to "is this joke funny", which means that a bunch of people who upvoted the original possibly wouldn't vote for this one, keeping it outside of any potential "unfunny joke" deletion ranges.)

That said, the addition of the last line sold me on that it's pretty funny. It feels out of place and basically leaves the reader curious to investigate more, which will inevitably take them to the discussion section, where they'll discover the entire anti-joke and how it's been set up (as well as what revision the original was.)

I think the execution could be slightly better though in terms of this, as this makes the joke fly over anyone who reads it not on the site (see -> the excellent ebooks).

Not sure how to improve on that though (maybe put the original on another page called SCP-7143-J-NSFW?), but as it is, great Joke SCP, even if it took me a while to find it funny.

Conclusion
